verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general Python/TypeScript SDKs and a claim that Honcho can be queried from 'any model or framework.' These are developer building blocks, not documented first-party integrations. The named integrations (an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin) target AI tools rather than agent frameworks. Nothing in the pack names LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK.
